tokens.name: cwl-sunrise
tokens.usage: Live-only. Sunrise: look here. Never in the base system, never on the facilitator or scribe views.

tokens.name: cwl-royal-deep
tokens.usage: Live-only. Deeper Royal for small text on blue (4.9:1 with Off-White; Off-White on Royal is 4.3:1).

tokens.name: cwl-sky-pale
tokens.usage: Tint: Sky Blue 25% (75% toward white). Group 9.

tokens.name: cwl-sky-light

tokens.name: cwl-sky-deep
tokens.usage: Shade: Sky Blue 20% toward Navy. Group 4.

tokens.name: cwl-soft-lime-deep
tokens.usage: Shade: Soft Lime 16% toward Navy. Group 5.

tokens.name: cwl-soft-lime-shade
tokens.usage: Shade: Soft Lime 30% toward Navy. Group 10.

tokens.name: cwl-bar-track-ink
tokens.usage: Navy 22% toward Royal. Empty bar track on Navy.

tokens.name: cwl-border-dark-ink
tokens.usage: Off-White at 15%: the base dark-variant border.

tokens.name: cwl-glow-ink
tokens.usage: Royal Blue at 45%: centre of the corner glow.

tokens.name: cwl-scrim-ink
tokens.usage: Navy at 88%: spotlight scrim on dark screens.

tokens.name: cwl-scrim-light-ink
tokens.usage: Off-White at 90%: spotlight scrim on light screens.

tokens.name: cwl-surface
tokens.usage: Screen background. Dark: every TV and phone screen. Light: light screens only.

tokens.name: cwl-surface-panel
tokens.usage: Highlighted panels, headers and large color blocks. Large text only on it (Off-White 4.3:1).

tokens.name: cwl-surface-panel-small
tokens.usage: Blue panels that carry small text (Off-White 4.9:1).

tokens.name: cwl-surface-card
tokens.usage: Light cards on the wall and phone answer surfaces.

tokens.name: cwl-text
tokens.usage: Main text on cwl-surface.

tokens.name: cwl-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, counts, sources on cwl-surface.

tokens.name: cwl-text-on-card
tokens.usage: Text on cwl-surface-card, group cards, lens fills, Lime and Sunrise blocks.

tokens.name: cwl-text-on-panel
tokens.usage: Text on cwl-surface-panel (large only) and cwl-surface-panel-small (any size).

tokens.name: cwl-accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, bars, active outlines. Shapes and large text only on Navy (3.3:1).

tokens.name: cwl-button-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (Send, Join). Deeper Royal, so a 16px label passes.

tokens.name: cwl-on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on cwl-button-primary (any size) or on cwl-accent (large only).

tokens.name: cwl-live
tokens.usage: LIVE: the LIVE marker, current session, confirm buttons, confirmed items, newest arrival, progress. One moment per screen.

tokens.name: cwl-on-live
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cwl-live fill.

tokens.name: cwl-callout
tokens.usage: LOOK HERE: spotlit item, key number, leading answer. One moment per screen. Never beside cwl-live.

tokens.name: cwl-on-callout
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cwl-callout fill.

tokens.name: cwl-bar
tokens.usage: Poll, ranking and 100-point bars.

tokens.name: cwl-bar-leader
tokens.usage: The leading bar (ties share it). This is the screen's Sunrise moment.

tokens.name: cwl-bar-track
tokens.usage: The empty track behind a bar.

tokens.name: cwl-bar-label
tokens.usage: Bar labels and values beside the bar.

tokens.name: cwl-cut-line
tokens.usage: The cut line across bars ("top five").

tokens.name: cwl-word-single
tokens.usage: Word cloud: one mention. Word clouds run on dark screens.

tokens.name: cwl-word-repeated
tokens.usage: Word cloud: repeated answers (anchors).

tokens.name: cwl-word-leader
tokens.usage: Word cloud: the leader, ties share it. Light screens: Navy text on a cwl-callout block.

tokens.name: cwl-word-new
tokens.usage: Word cloud: a new word for its Lime moment (1200ms), then it settles. Light: Navy on a cwl-live block.

tokens.name: cwl-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card edges that carry no meaning.

tokens.name: cwl-border-strong
tokens.usage: Input outlines and edges that must be seen (3:1).

tokens.name: cwl-focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and assistive focus on phones. 3px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: cwl-presence
tokens.usage: Names arriving on the join screen and presence counts.

tokens.name: cwl-texture-ink
tokens.usage: Ink of the mark texture. Always at a cwl-tex opacity, dark screens only.

tokens.name: cwl-glow
tokens.usage: The soft Royal corner glow. Dark screens only.

tokens.name: cwl-scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a spotlit item. Items under it are hidden, not read.

tokens.name: cwl-fac-private-surface

tokens.name: cwl-fac-private-text

tokens.name: cwl-radius-pill

tokens.name: cwl-shadow-tv

tokens.name: cwl-shadow-phone

tokens.name: cwl-dur-arrive
tokens.usage: Arriving: a new item fades and settles where it lands.

tokens.name: cwl-dur-make-room
tokens.usage: Making room: neighbours glide aside (FLIP).

tokens.name: cwl-dur-swell
tokens.usage: Swelling: a repeated word grows and shifts color.

tokens.name: cwl-dur-new-hold
tokens.usage: How long the newest arrival keeps its Lime moment.

tokens.name: cwl-dur-settle-color
tokens.usage: A color settling back after its moment.

tokens.name: cwl-dur-bar-grow
tokens.usage: Bars growing from their previous value.

tokens.name: cwl-dur-bar-trade
tokens.usage: Bars trading places with a smooth slide.

tokens.name: cwl-dur-cut-line
tokens.usage: The cut line sliding, locked to the bar trade.

tokens.name: cwl-dur-regroup
tokens.usage: Drifting into groups: slower, calmer.

tokens.name: cwl-dur-label-grow
tokens.usage: Group labels growing as groups gather.

tokens.name: cwl-dur-count
tokens.usage: A count ticking to its new value.

tokens.name: cwl-dur-phones-dim
tokens.usage: Phones dimming for phones down, base dur-slow.

tokens.name: cwl-dur-spotlight-on
tokens.usage: Spotlight on: the item lifts, the scrim rises.

tokens.name: cwl-dur-spotlight-off
tokens.usage: Spotlight off: base dur-mochary.

tokens.name: cwl-dur-hide
tokens.usage: Hide: the item fades and shrinks away.

tokens.name: cwl-dur-reduced
tokens.usage: Reduced motion: the still equivalent's fade, base dur-fast.

tokens.name: cwl-ease-signature
tokens.usage: Base signature easing. Default for every movement.

tokens.name: cwl-ease-arrive
tokens.usage: Decelerate only, for arrivals and labels growing.

tokens.name: cwl-ease-calm
tokens.usage: Gentle in and out, for regrouping and spotlight.

tokens.name: cwl-ease-exit
tokens.usage: Accelerate out, for hide.

tokens.name: cwl-delay-stagger
tokens.usage: Steady flow: spacing between arrivals when many land at once.

tokens.name: cwl-delay-stagger-min
tokens.usage: The tightest spacing the flow compresses to.

tokens.name: cwl-delay-max-hold
tokens.usage: No answer is held longer than this after receipt.

tokens.name: cwl-delay-regroup-step
tokens.usage: Cascade between cards drifting into groups, max 12 steps.

tokens.name: cwl-delay-label-after-drift

tokens.name: cwl-delay-make-room-after-hide
tokens.usage: Neighbours close the gap this long after a hide starts.

tokens.name: cwl-delay-swell-color
tokens.usage: Color shift starts with the swell.
